title: DreameHome MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated…
description: DreameHome MQTT broker versions before 2026-10-26 have an authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to subscribe to status topics of devices they do not own or have access to. This unauthorized subscription exposes sensitive telemetry data including LiDAR map frames revealing home layouts, Wi-Fi network details, local IP information, firmware versions, and session keys for encrypted video.
